routine.title: Stretch & Mobility
routine.notes: 4-6 week football mobility block. Move slowly and stay below sharp pain. Weeks 1-2: own the positions. Weeks 3-4: add 2 reps or 10-15 sec where comfortable. Weeks 5-6: keep the same control and gradually increase depth/range. Main benchmarks: knee-to-wall, straight-leg raise, front split and middle split.

exercises.notes: 2 sets each side. Keep heel flat and drive knee over 2nd/3rd toe. Start with the foot close enough that the knee touches the wall without the heel lifting. Gradually move the foot back. Track your best pain-free distance in cm.

Sit tall with both knees bent about 90 degrees. Rotate both knees side-to-side under control without using momentum. Keep both hips as heavy as possible on the floor. One rep = switch to the opposite side.
Move into a wide stance, sit into one hip while the other leg stays long. Keep the working foot planted and chest tall. Go only as deep as you can control. Alternate sides; reps are per side.
Heels flat, knees tracking over toes, ribs stacked. Sit as low as you can without collapsing. Use elbows inside the knees if useful. Goal over the block: build toward a relaxed 2-minute hold.

Lie on your back with one leg straight on the floor. Raise the other leg with the knee locked and toes pulled toward you; do not let the pelvis roll. Reps are per side. Track how close you get to 90 degrees while staying controlled.

From 90/90, keep the front thigh down and gently lift the front foot/shin away from the floor to train active internal rotation. Small clean range is fine. No twisting through the lower back. Reps are per side.
Set one knee near a wall/bench with shin behind you, opposite foot in front. Squeeze the glute of the kneeling side and keep ribs down. Do not arch the lower back. Set 1 left, set 2 right.

Use supports/blocks if needed. Square the hips, front knee straight, back leg long. Sink only to strong stretch, not pain. Set 1 left leg forward; set 2 right leg forward. Measure floor gap every 1-2 weeks, not every session.

Take a wide stance/straddle and slide out gradually with feet and knees aligned. Keep tension through the legs rather than hanging passively. Stop well before sharp groin pain. Track floor gap every 1-2 weeks.
